description: Call 2 of the call_two_amounts deal, days later: Ramesh says the total was 14,000, which contradicts the 13,000 both agreed on call 1; Sunita corrects him. Replayed after call_two_amounts on the same deal (call_no 2).

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Hello madam, Ramesh bol raha hoon. Kal se kaam shuru karna hai na?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Kamron se saamaan hata diya hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Achha madam, ek baat. Labour ka total 14 hazaar tay hua tha na?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Nahi nahi, 13 hazaar tay hua tha. Aapne khud last bola tha.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan haan madam, 13 hi. Galti se bol diya.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai. Aur paint aa gaya hai, bhai ki dukaan se.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam. Kal subah 10 baje pahunch jaunga.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, kal milte hain. Bye.
